verdict.rationale: Docs describe flows built from triggers and actions, connecting 764 apps without writing glue code, positioning Activepieces as a no-code Zapier alternative with a visual flow builder. Community evidence corroborates it as an open-source Zapier-style tool, though one hands-on report notes setup friction and a bug, not specific to the visual builder itself. missing for 10: independent hands-on validation of the visual editor UX itself, screenshots/demos of multi-step drag-and-drop building, and detail on error handling/branching within the no-code editor.
